title: Observe Rubric Evaluation Journal Contract v1
description: Append-only evaluations in .fgos/observe/evals/<writerId>.jsonl. The writer owns v/type/ts; callers supply the remaining fields. evalId is globally unique across shards, checked under the shared Observe lock; cross-record uniqueness is not expressible in this schema. Scores are validated on write and read.

ts.description: Writer-owned ISO 8601 capture time, using the Observe clock convention.

question.description: Verbatim text of the exact question shared by every compared arm (it may be the full objective). `metrics eval list --question` matches it by exact string equality.

setup.description: Identifier of the recorded protocol, roles, personas, providers and models.

judge.description: Judge run/setup identifier, not just a model family label.

runRefs.description: Caller-written references to the actual evaluated runs and their evidence; the store does not parse or resolve them. Examples in use: `unit-run:<unitRunId>`, or one `;`-separated `key=value` string naming project, unit, run, the evaluated report path and the judge evidence path. Any path must name the actual evaluated output, not a guessed report.
